title: Genomic.DAO Series 27 — Genome Campus on the Cam
summary: A walkable DAO campus on Cam farmland at Hinxton: agents monitor, synthesize and draft in labs and forums while humans hold every final vote. Six zones ring the river meadow, from Charter Hall to the Progress Observatory.

districts.real_anchor: Wellcome Genome Campus entrance drive, Hinxton

buildings.name: Outcome Ledger House
buildings.use: Measurable-outcomes registry and public reading room

districts.real_anchor: Hinxton village edge, near the campus labs
campus central lawn between laboratory blocks

buildings.name: Forum Rotunda
buildings.use: Proposal debate and human decision chamber

buildings.name: Drafter's Annex
buildings.use: Agent drafting office for proposals and grants

districts.real_anchor: operations buildings along the campus access road
raised ground overlooking the River Cam water meadows

court.name: The Helix Court
court.style: open grass court ringed by path segments like base pairs
court.why_here: A shared court on the campus lawn where sequenced genomes were decoded, letting stewards gather between zones.

quests.title: Read the Reserved Powers
steps: Find the engraved charter plinth
List the six human-reserved actions
Watch agents draft at the Review Table
Cast a practice vote in the gallery

quests.title: Trace the Evidence
steps: Ask Evidence Monitor for the day's summary
Collect three citations from the stacks
Carry the synthesis to the Progress Tracker
Log the outcome on the heatmap wall

quests.title: Route the Working Group
steps: Accept a routed task from the Task Router
Recruit a collaborator suggested by the Scout
Deliver the brief to the Synthesis Studio
Report back at the Signal Board

quests.title: From Draft to Decision
steps: Review the Drafter's latest proposal
Debate it at the circular dais
Record the human vote result
Archive the outcome in the Ledger House

quests.title: Milestone on the Mead
steps: Climb to the Telescope Platform
Read the milestone dial
Light the Beacon Tower signal
Dispatch follow-up tasks via the Routing Console
